X1 SkyRacer Fan-Tilt

The fixed-angle version: rear lift ducts set 10° forward, pushers lowered 4 in, shortened to 0.39 m and tilted 10° exhaust-down. White lower body, a slim tail spine between the pushers, and a pylon to each fuel sponson. The wings now fold on real hinges set on the skins, with no parts passing through each other. The engine and accumulator sit 5.1 in lower, clearing the rear wing, and the belly is deepened under the engine bay. Drag the slider to watch it fold for the hauler.

Every fold hinge sits on the skin on the inside of its fold. The rear wing is 6.3 in lower. Its 10% thick outer panel twists into the duct's plane, and the duct hinge runs in that plane. The ducts' inboard lower lip is trimmed flat at the hinge, and the lower rotors stop at a set angle before folding.
